title: Secrets · bootstrap and delivery
subtitle: Git holds references. The operator owns values. External Secrets delivers them.
description: Flux installs Vault and ESO. The operator initializes and unseals Vault; Terraform configures Kubernetes authentication and the KV mount. ESO uses Kubernetes identity to authenticate, reads approved values, and synchronizes monitoring Kubernetes Secrets. The monitoring release waits for readiness.

nodes.title: Installation · Flux
lines: Install Vault + External Secrets, then declare ClusterSecretStore and ExternalSecrets
Running pods alone do not prove provider authentication works.

nodes.title: Configuration · operator + Terraform
lines: Operator: initialize, unseal, and populate monitoring credentials
Terraform: Kubernetes auth · KV mount · policy · ESO role / audience

nodes.title: Consumption · monitoring workloads
lines: Grafana admin login · Traefik Basic Auth for Prometheus
The monitoring chart waits for the credential readiness gate.

notes.text: Homepage and Linkding reconcile independently. Inactive Postiz and Cloudflared are not on this path.
A Vault restart needs unsealing again. Git and Terraform do not back up application secret values.
